关键词: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
主要内容: A new Global Supply Chain Pressure Index, developed by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, indicates that supply-chain pressures have reached their highest level since at least 1997. However, the index suggests that these pressures may be peaking and could start to moderate in the future. The index, created by researchers Gianluca Benigno, Julian di Giovanni, Jan J. J. Groen, and Adam I. Noble, incorporates 27 variables to assess cross-border transportation costs, country-level manufacturing data, and other factors across the euro area, China, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the U.K., and the U.S.

股票实体.名称: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
